description: OPTIONAL BUT JUSTIFIED. Global alias table that collapses 'React', 'React.js' and 'ReactJS' into one canonical skill. Without it, match scoring silently under-reports (a user with 'ReactJS' would show a gap for a job asking 'React.js') and the admin 'top skill gaps' chart splits one skill across several bars. Shared reference data, so it is a collection rather than embedded anywhere.

normalizedName.description: Unique canonical key, e.g. 'react'. This is what gets written into profiles.skills[].normalizedName.

aliases.description: Already-normalised alternative spellings, e.g. ['react js','reactjs']. Indexed multikey so alias -> canonical resolution is a single indexed lookup.

relatedSkills.description: normalizedName values of adjacent skills. Enables partial-credit semantic scoring ('Spring' ~ 'Spring Boot') and 'learn this next' suggestions for skill gaps.

weight.description: Relative importance used by the scorer. Lets a niche framework outrank a generic term like 'programming'.
